title: Compress task function vectors extracted from a small pretrained causal LM
hypothesis: On four held-out in-context relation functions in Pythia-70m-deduped, projecting support-extracted function vectors into a rank-4 shared basis will preserve held-out query accuracy within 5 percentage points and mean gold-candidate log-probability within 0.10 nats of explicit vectors, using <=0.50x their actual vector payload bytes in both development worlds.
physical_object: Frozen EleutherAI/pythia-70m-deduped causal LM at pinned Hugging Face revision e93a9faa9c77e5d09219f6c868bfc7a1bd65593c; 6 layers, hidden size 512.
mirror_coordinate: One rank-r shared hidden-state basis fitted to function vectors from task IDs 0-11, plus a per-function coefficient code m_t for each of 16 functions; held-out task IDs 12-15 are coded from their own support extraction but never affect the shared basis.
logical_multiplicity: Sixteen ICL relation functions, with four relation directions excluded from shared-basis fitting and evaluated on eight disjoint key/value queries each.
controls: Explicit full hidden-state function vector per task from support demonstrations
Native centered PCA basis and per-task coefficients using identical fit tasks and decoder
Random/task-ID metadata and model/tokenizer common payload accounting

task.type: pretrained-small-LM in-context relation retrieval with support-extracted task vectors
task.condition: Each task is a fixed 16-entry one-to-one relation. A seeded split selects eight support pairs and eight disjoint evaluation queries, so each held-out task has exactly eight distinct answer candidates. Function vectors are the mean activation difference at the final Output delimiter between leave-one-support-pair-out demonstration prompts and the corresponding query-only prompts.
task.query_metric: For each held-out query, score the eight evaluation answer candidates by summed teacher-forced token log probability; report top-1 accuracy, gold candidate log probability, and mean gold-vs-best-negative margin.
task.construction: Sixteen relation tasks are fixed in source: country-capital and inverse; country-currency and inverse; state-postal-code and inverse; element-symbol and inverse; number-word-digit and inverse; animal-sound and inverse; English-French and inverse; English-Spanish and inverse. Tasks 0-11 fit the basis. Tasks 12-15 are held out from basis fitting. Model weights remain frozen; no gradient updates.

development.selection: Report every fixed rank and every task; primary rank4 on basis-heldout task IDs 12-15. Do not tune prompts, layer, alpha or task lists after seeing results.

fresh.opening_rule: Open only if explicit FV gains at least .05 held-out accuracy or .15 mean gold log-probability over no intervention, rank4 passes both preservation gates and actual bytes, and Mirror has a useful >=10% margin over native PCA.

storage.authority: actual uncompressed NPZ bytes for intervention state
paid_objects: explicit vectors or basis and all task codes
pinned base-model digest in each payload
storage.common_base: Also report actual total deployment bytes including all pinned model weights, config and tokenizer. Common base bytes are identical across methods and are not omitted from the absolute total.

compute.report_extra_activation_ops: Count 512 additions for each of 256 held-out candidate sequences, plus one 512*r basis decode per each of four held-out function IDs; explicit-vector control pays the same additions without code decode.
compute.hardware: CPU only, fixed five-thread limit; no GPU.

gates.LEARNABILITY: Explicit task vectors must exceed no-intervention held-out top-1 accuracy by >=0.05 absolute or held-out mean gold candidate log-probability by >=0.15 nats in both worlds; otherwise NOT ESTABLISHED for this task set.
gates.PROMISING: If learnability passes, rank4 Mirror held-out top-1 accuracy is no more than .05 below explicit FV, mean gold log-probability no more than .10 nats lower, and intervention payload <=0.50x explicit FV bytes in both worlds; native PCA must also leave >=10% useful margin.
gates.FAIL: Learnability passes but any frozen rank4 quality/storage gate fails, or native PCA exactly matches the function payload/output without a Mirror-specific margin.
gates.NOT_ESTABLISHED: Explicit FVs do not clear the frozen task-learnability gate, pinned model artifacts fail integrity checks, or deterministic payload/output replay fails.

boundaries: One 70M pretrained model and controlled relation tasks; not a broad language benchmark or production-scale LLM result.
Candidate answer sets are supplied to all methods for constrained ranking; this evaluates relation retrieval, not open-ended generation.
A fixed model task vector is estimated from eight demonstrations; support extraction cost is reported, not hidden.
A compression result that is exactly ordinary PCA is not Mirror-specific evidence. Fresh remains sealed if native attribution fails.
